product_summary: Salius Pharma Pvt. Ltd. (Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra) is a pharma/API house, not a food/FMCG company. Own website (saliuspharma.com) product lines: (1) Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients - a long list of ~120 molecules with CAS numbers (Aceclofenac, Acyclovir, Albendazole, Amoxicillin Trihydrate, Azithromycin Dihydrate, Cefadroxil, Esomeprazole Magnesium, Famotidine, Ranitidine HCl, Sildenafil Citrate, Selenium Sulfide, Povidone Iodine, Iodine, Potassium Iodide, Zinc Sulphate, Glucosamine HCl, etc.); (2) Generic Formulations (tablets, capsules, syrups, injectables, ointments, eye/ear drops, IV infusion); (3) Excipients; (4) DC Granules & Pellets; (5) Pharmaceutical Intermediates; (6) Impurities; (7) Nutraceutical Ingredients - ~150+ items incl. amino acids (L-Lysine, L-Methionine, L-Tryptophan, Taurine, L-Carnitine), vitamins (A Palmitate, B1, B9, B12), minerals (calcium carbonate, zinc oxide, ferrous fumarate, magnesium oxide, sodium bicarbonate, potassium bicarbonate), enzymes (papain, pepsin, pancreatin, lactase, lipase), proteins (whey protein concentrate/isolate, pea protein, rice protein, sodium caseinate), fish/krill/flaxseed/evening primrose oils, herbal extracts (silymarin, curcumin, spirulina), Lactulose solution, Lactitol, Polydextrose, Pectin. IndiaMART storefront additionally lists specialty chemicals, hydrogen peroxide, industrial chemicals & fertilizers, hospital furniture & equipment, medical devices/implants/sutures, surgical disposables, cosmetic raw material.
comment: HS mismatch - company retained, code to be corrected (per Rule 3). Declared 170211 (lactose and lactose syrup, milk sugar) and 281390 (sulphides of arsenic / phosphorus sulphides) are both wrong for this supplier. 170211 is at best a marginal partial hit: the company does offer lactose-adjacent carbohydrates (Lactulose solution, Lactitol monohydrate, D-Mannose, Polydextrose, Pectin) but no lactose/milk sugar is listed on either the website or the IndiaMART catalogue - so even that is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. 281390 has no plausible link at all: the closest sulphur compound in the range is Selenium Sulfide (293090) and Methyl Sulfonyl Methane (293090), not arsenic/phosphorus sulphides. Industry classification 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: the real industry is pharmaceuticals / API / nutraceutical raw materials (CIN prefix U24233 = manufacture of pharmaceuticals, per IndiaMART listing). Trader signs are explicit: IndiaMART declares 'Nature of Business: Trader - Wholesaler/Distributor', while the own site claims 'manufacturer' and 'Marketing and Development' of APIs - i.e. manufacturer_trader at best, with the manufacturing claim unverified. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: all APIs (~120 molecules), generic formulations (3004), antibiotics (2941), vitamins (2936), amino acids (2922), enzymes/proteins (3504), fish and vegetable oils (1504/1515), herbal extracts (1302), iodine and iodides (2801/2827), hydrogen peroxide (2847), and hospital furniture/medical devices (9018/9402). No customs line was available to me in this task, so every HS mapping above is derived from the published catalogue only and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. Sources: https://saliuspharma.com/ ; https://saliuspharma.com/products/apis/ ; https://saliuspharma.com/products/nutraceutical-ingredients/ ; https://www.saliuspharma.in/ (IndiaMART storefront).
